title: Respect and Growth
prompt: Describe a time when you learned the importance of respecting your teachers or mentors.
hint: Think about an experience where respecting guidance helped you grow or succeed.
sample: I once ignored my teacher's advice, but later I realized that respecting her guidance helped me improve my skills.

ja.prompt: 先生や指導者を尊敬することの大切さを学んだ経験について話してください。
ja.hint: 尊敬することで成長や成功につながった経験を考えてみましょう。
ja.sample: 私はかつて先生の助言を無視しましたが、後でその指導を尊敬することが自分の成長に役立つと気づきました。

local.prompt: Describe a time when you learned the importance of respecting your teachers or mentors.

local.sample: I once ignored my teacher's advice, but later I realized that respecting her guidance helped me improve my skills.

zh.prompt: 描述一次你學會尊重老師或導師重要性的經歷。
zh.hint: 想想尊重指導如何幫助你成長或成功的經驗。
zh.sample: 我曾經忽視老師的建議，但後來我意識到尊重她的指導幫助我提升了技能。

en.prompt: Describe a time when you learned the importance of respecting your teachers or mentors.
en.hint: Think about an experience where respecting guidance helped you grow or succeed.
en.sample: I once ignored my teacher's advice, but later I realized that respecting her guidance helped me improve my skills.

title: Lesson from Planting Seeds
prompt: Explain the lesson Mrs. Eliza taught her students using the seed planting activity.
hint: Consider how taking care of plants relates to personal growth and respect.
sample: Mrs. Eliza showed that just like plants need care and attention to grow, students need respect and effort to learn and develop.

ja.prompt: エリザ先生が種まきの活動を通して生徒たちに教えた教訓を説明してください。
ja.hint: 植物の世話が個人の成長や尊敬とどのように関係しているか考えてみましょう。
ja.sample: エリザ先生は、植物が成長するために世話と注意が必要なように、生徒も学び成長するためには尊敬と努力が必要だと示しました。

local.sample: Mrs. Eliza showed that just like plants need care and attention to grow, students need respect and effort to learn and develop.

zh.prompt: 說明伊莉莎老師用種植種子的活動教給學生的課程。
zh.hint: 思考照顧植物如何與個人成長和尊重相關。
zh.sample: 伊莉莎老師示範了就像植物需要照顧和關注才能成長，學生也需要尊重和努力才能學習和發展。

title: Change and Apology
prompt: Write about a time when you or someone you know apologized and changed their behavior after realizing a mistake.
hint: Focus on the feelings of regret and the positive changes that followed.
sample: After realizing my mistake, I apologized sincerely and worked hard to improve my attitude and actions.

ja.prompt: 自分や知っている人が間違いに気づいて謝罪し、行動を改めた経験について書いてください。
ja.hint: 後悔の気持ちとその後の良い変化に注目しましょう。
ja.sample: 自分の間違いに気づいた後、心から謝罪し、態度や行動を改善するために努力しました。

local.prompt: Write about a time when you or someone you know apologized and changed their behavior after realizing a mistake.

local.sample: After realizing my mistake, I apologized sincerely and worked hard to improve my attitude and actions.

zh.prompt: 寫一寫你或你認識的人在意識到錯誤後道歉並改變行為的經歷。
zh.hint: 著重於悔恨的感受和隨後的正面改變。
zh.sample: 意識到錯誤後，我真誠地道歉，並努力改善我的態度和行為。

en.prompt: Write about a time when you or someone you know apologized and changed their behavior after realizing a mistake.

en.sample: After realizing my mistake, I apologized sincerely and worked hard to improve my attitude and actions.
